name: Jennie Lee
reason: Too thin once the rules are applied. Her site (jennieleeyogatherapy.com, now redirecting to jennieleecoaching.com) offers yoga therapy and spiritual coaching sessions (contact form only, no price), but her three books (True Yoga, Breathing Love, Spark Change) are linked only through amzn.to with no ISBN on her own pages, and no publisher page we may read gave one (Spark Change is a Sounds True title, which is off limits; one search found no Llewellyn page). Her retreats are past (next 'spring 2028', no page), she has no YouTube channel linked, and her site publishes no base (only past Hawaii retreats; 'Kailua' appears only on third-party pages). Her coaching is framed partly as yoga therapy and counselling. Owner may want to look.
